title: Calls to Wiom by when they came against the install slot
description: Per call day (IST): calls to Wiom between engineer assignment and installation, split by the stage Wiom's support IVR recorded: before the slot day, on it, in the grace period, after it had passed, after cancellation, or other.

args.sql:
-- Calls to Wiom between engineer assignment and installation (same calls as goal_calls), per call day (IST),
-- split by when they came against the install slot. The stage is the one Wiom's support IVR records on each call
-- (CUSTOMER_INBOUND_CALL_LOG.LAST_STAGE): before the slot day, on the slot day, within the installation grace period,
-- after the slot day had passed, after the booking was cancelled, or anything else.
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT CONNECTION_ID, RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(TO_VARCHAR(MOBILE), '[^0-9]', ''), 10) AS M10,
         ASSIGNED_TIME AS A, COALESCE(INSTALL_TIME, '2099-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS I
  FROM PROD_DB.DBT.COMPANY_B_CONNECTION_BOOKING_ENRICHED
  WHERE ASSIGNED_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ASSIGNED_TIME >= '2026-08-15'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONNECTION_ID ORDER BY ASSIGNED_TIME DESC) = 1
), ib AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.CALL_ID, x.T, x.STAGE
  FROM (SELECT CALL_ID, RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(FROM_NUMBER), 10) AS M10, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CREATED_AT)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS T, LAST_STAGE AS STAGE
        FROM PROD_DB.POSTGRES_RDS_PARTNER_CALL_LOG_IVR.CUSTOMER_INBOUND_CALL_LOG WHERE CREATED_AT >= '2026-09-01'
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CALL_ID ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST) = 1) x
  JOIN coh c ON c.M10 = x.M10 AND x.T BETWEEN c.A AND c.I
)
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(DATE(T), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY,
  CASE STAGE
    WHEN 'CALL_BEFORE_SLOT_CONFIRMED_DATE' THEN 'before_slot'
    WHEN 'CALL_ON_SLOT_CONFIRMED_DATE' THEN 'on_slot_day'
    WHEN 'CALL_WITHIN_INSTALLATION_GRACE_PERIOD' THEN 'grace'
    WHEN 'CALL_AFTER_SLOT_CONFIRMED_DATE' THEN 'after_slot'
    WHEN 'LEAD_CANCELLED_BY_WIOM' THEN 'cancelled'
    WHEN 'LEAD_CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER' THEN 'cancelled'
    ELSE 'other' END AS WHEN_CALLED,
  COUNT(*) AS CALLS
FROM ib GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
